description: Defines the DemuxerStreamAdapter class responsible for fetching audio/video buffers from a demuxer and sending them via Mojo remoting interface, primarily used within Chromium media remoting infrastructure.

classes.name: DemuxerStreamAdapter
classes.description: Handles fetching media buffers from a demuxer stream and sending data via Mojo remoting, managing RPC messaging, data pipe writing, and error handling.

methods.name: DemuxerStreamAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with task runners, demuxer stream, RPC messenger, and data pipe handles.

methods.name: GetBytesWrittenAndReset
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes written to the data pipe since last reset.

methods.name: SignalFlush
methods.description: Signals start or end of flush operation, returning frame count or nullopt.

methods.name: is_processing_read_request
methods.description: Checks if a read request is in progress.

methods.name: is_data_pending
methods.description: Checks if data is pending to be written.
